description: This file defines the 'Clock' class which provides methods to control and manipulate the clock in a browser testing context, such as installing, fast forwarding, pausing, resuming, and setting fixed or system times. It interacts with a BrowserContext via a channel and includes utility functions for parsing time and tick values.

classes.name: Clock
classes.description: A class providing methods to control and simulate different clock behaviors within a browser testing context.

methods.name: install
methods.description: Installs or overrides the clock with specified options, such as setting an initial time.

methods.name: fastForward
methods.description: Advances the clock by a specified amount of ticks.

methods.name: pauseAt
methods.description: Pauses the clock at a specified point in time.

methods.name: resume
methods.description: Resumes the clock if it was paused.

methods.name: runFor
methods.description: Runs the clock forward for a specified number of ticks.

methods.name: setFixedTime
methods.description: Sets the clock to a fixed specific time.

methods.name: setSystemTime
methods.description: Sets the system time for the browser context.

methods.name: function parseTicks(ticks: string | number): { ticksNumber?: number, ticksString?: string } { parseTicks
function parseTime(time: string | number | Date): { timeNumber?: number, timeString?: string } { parseTime

ctags.name: parseTicks
ctags.pattern: /^function parseTicks(ticks: string | number): { ticksNumber?: number, ticksString?: string } {$/

ctags.pattern: /^function parseTime(time: string | number | Date): { timeNumber?: number, timeString?: string } {$/
